title: Group Contingencies and Class-Wide Systems
sub: Design a class-wide behavior system, print the poster the class sees, and keep the daily record beside it. The form holds the three group contingencies the literature names (independent, dependent, interdependent), the Good Behavior Game, CW-FIT, randomized components and the mystery motivator, class-wide self-monitoring at a cue, and tootling; writes the rule out in plain words; and applies the criterion and fading rules the team sets.
